title: Red panda eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#c8502a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#e07a4a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M26 78 Q14 74 12 62 Q11 54 18 52 Q26 51 28 60 Q30 68 30 74 Z' fill='#b8431f'/>
  <path d='M20 56 Q22 60 24 58' stroke='#e8b06a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M16 64 Q20 66 22 63' stroke='#e8b06a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#c8502a'/>
  <!-- ear left -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='22' r='7' fill='#b8431f'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- ear right -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='22' r='7' fill='#b8431f'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- face white patches -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='40' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#f5e6d0'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='40' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#f5e6d0'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='7' ry='5.5' fill='#f5e6d0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#2a1a12'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#2a1a12'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='37' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='2.6' ry='2' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M46 50 Q50 54 54 50' stroke='#3a2418' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tear/cheek marks -->
  <path d='M36 44 L38 47' stroke='#b8431f' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 44 L62 47' stroke='#b8431f' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms holding snack -->
  <path d='M36 62 Q34 54 40 52' stroke='#c8502a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 62 Q66 54 60 52' stroke='#c8502a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: green apple -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='7' fill='#6fbf4a'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='57' r='2' fill='#a8e07a'/>
  <path d='M50 53 Q51 50 54 50' stroke='#4a8a2f' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- apple bite -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='57' r='2.6' fill='#f5e6d0'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4.5' fill='#8f3316'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4.5' fill='#8f3316'/>
</svg>
